# Tyler (Ty) Collins

Tyler Collins builds agent-run reporting and analytics systems. Work and personal projects in agentic AI, data engineering and BI.

## Projects

- https://tylercollins.pages.dev/projects/collins-capital — An AI fund manager trades my own money in a Robinhood account under a written rulebook. Value trading backed by sentiment.
- https://tylercollins.pages.dev/projects/desk-display — A 7-inch read-only portfolio display for a Raspberry Pi Zero 2 W. Privacy mode shows percentages only, and a missing number stays missing.
- https://tylercollins.pages.dev/projects/ai-search-visibility — An independent study of whether AI answers name General Electric Credit Union when someone in Cincinnati asks where to bank. 383 scored answers from public models.
- https://tylercollins.pages.dev/projects/competitor-watch — An independent public-data watch on GECU and Cincinnati-area credit unions: rates, branches, NCUA call data, app reviews, and job posts.
- https://tylercollins.pages.dev/projects/job-tracker — A daily pipeline that reads 70 company job boards, filters about 7,000 postings and scores each match against a resume.
- https://tylercollins.pages.dev/projects/reporting-pipeline — An agent-driven reporting workflow at a credit union: Jira request, agent draft on governed data, human review, production release.
- https://tylercollins.pages.dev/projects/scorigami — Interactive maps of every final score in MLB and Big East basketball history, plus a jackpot game concept built on NFL scores.
- https://tylercollins.pages.dev/projects/barbuildr — A mobile app that helps someone build a home whiskey bar and recommends the next bottle based on what's missing.
